column1: # Portuguese letter names for character-by-character navigation (#123).
# eSpeak's own pt letter naming is inconsistent (é -> "é agudo" but ó -> "ó"),
# so name the accented letters explicitly. Shared by pt, pt-br, pt-pt.
# A name's first word must be read with the letter's vowel: eSpeak reads a
# bare "e" as [i] and "o" as [u], and its own "ê"/"ô" as open [ɛ]/[ɔ], so
# ê and ô are written "êh"/"ôh" ([e]/[o]) and õ is "ó til" (#130).
# tests/test_letter_names_pt.py checks every name against eSpeak.
